fused form mayā+uditāḥ; passive participle feminine nominative plural agreeing with mudrā

items.question: Which mudrās belonging to Tripurā has the speaker declared to the great goddess?
premises: The addressee is the great goddess.
items.inference: The verse closes the mudrā instruction by attributing these Tripurā mudrās to the speaker's teaching to the goddess.
uncertainties: The fused form mayoditāḥ may encode mayā+uditāḥ; exact root and voice are not fully certain.
items.plain_english: These mudrās of Tripurā have been spoken by me, O great goddess.
